Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: ltvmw dilg gov.ph OPINION NO. 15 MR. EDUARDO G. SOCIAS, JR. Office of the Municipal Treasurer Municipality of Getafe Province of Bohol Dear Mr. Socias: s. 2019- This has reference to your letter dated 24 July 2017 seeking for clarification whether or not you could implement Municipal Ordinance No. 02, S.2016, entitled "AN ORDINANCE IMPOSING PASSENGER'S ENVIRONMENTAL FEE TO ALL PASSENGERS PASSING vv1THIN THE JURISDICTION OF GETAFE, ENTERING GETAFE PORT GOING TO ANY PORTOFDESTINATIONABOARDMOTOIVBANCA, SHIP, FERRYBOATOR OTHER SEA VESSEL". Per your letter, Mayor Casey Shaun M. Camacho, Getafe, Bohol issued Memorandum Order No. 03 dated 5 June 2017 for purposes of implementing Municipal Ordinance No. 2, S.2016 since the said ordinance has been declared by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan ng Bohol, through Resolution No. 2017-63 dated 7 February 2017 valid pursuant to the provisions of the Local Government Code (LGC). Nevertheless, you are hesitant to implement the said law because of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2017-23 dated 6 February 2017. To answer your query, may we emphasize that Section 133(e) of the Local Government Code provides that: "SECTION 133. Common Limitations on the Taxing Powers of Local Government Units. — Unless otherwise provided herein, the exercise of the taxing powers ofprovinces, cities municipalities, and barangays shall not extend to the levy of the following: (e) Taxes, fees, and charges and otherimpositions upon goods carried into or out of, or passing through the territorial jurisdictions of local government units in theguise of wharfage, tolls for bridges or otherwise, or other taxes, fees, or charges in any form whatsoever upon such goods or merchandise. " xxx

Perusal of the above-quoted provision, it appears that the prohibition on the imposition of taxes, fees, and charges applies only to goods or merchandise. The prohibition did not include tax on passengers. Hence, this Department believes that the subject ordinance can be implemented in view of the above-mentioned provision of the LGC. Lastly, please be informed that this Department has already issued DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2018-1331, advising the LGUs to suspend the imposition and collection of illegal fees and taxes relative to the transport of goods and merchandise. It follows also that the prohibition on imposition of fees and taxes covers only goods or merchandise, and does not include tax on passengers. Please be guided accordingly. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: C. SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Undersecretary CC: Dir. Leocadio T. Trovela Regional Director DILG-Region VII Sudlon, Lahug Cebu City " Dated, 16 August 2018
